habitat: Cambrian marine water-column and near-seabed teaching reconstruction
habitat_zh: 寒武纪海洋水体及近海底教学复原
claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired teaching art using basic recognizable form, not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact species/measurement/locomotion/coexistence claim.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism interpretation: small domed anterior head plate, a large median eye behind it, paired stalked lateral eyes, long segmented trunk, paired swimming flaps, rake-like frontal appendages and four filamentous tail blades. Nominal art proportions and colors; no brain, gill microstructure or exact spine-tooth counts claimed. Soft closed parts deliberately overlap at organic roots; no detached appendage placement.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创全身生活复原：小型前部拱头甲、位于甲后的中央眼、两侧具柄眼、细长分节躯干、成对游泳瓣、耙状前附肢与四条丝状尾叶。尺寸比例及色彩为艺术设定；不复原脑或鳃微观结构，不主张精确刺齿数。封闭软组织部件在根部有意交叠连接。

name.zh: 史丹利虾属启发的细长三眼放射齿动物

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish small domed head plate, median eye and slender trunk with four tail blades in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以小型穹顶头甲、中眼及带四枚尾叶的细长躯干搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。
